routes.authored_test_clause: Test a delayed escalation, discovery by an agent, a shorter contractual limit, incomplete initial information and oral/written law-enforcement delays. Reject clocks restarted at management confirmation and treating day 60 as the routine target.
routes.authored_title: Track occurrence, first knowledge, reasonable-diligence discovery and upstream contractual deadlines separately. Calculate the outer 60-day date while requiring prompt action and honoring shorter contracts. Send available affected-person and notice information and supplement promptly. Record written delay terms or the official and date of an oral delay, capped at 30 days unless supported by a written statement.
routes.exact_clause_limit: Synthetic notice SLAs exist; no occurrence/knowledge/discovery timeline, actual affected-person information, notice, shorter-contract reperforming or law-enforcement delay case.

routes.authored_test_clause: Exercise an electronic-copy request, an accepted amendment and an accounting request on synthetic data; trace the correct recipient, complete records and upstream completion requirements.
routes.authored_title: Define the BA/customer allocation for access, amendment and accounting. Authenticate requests, route promptly under agreed time limits, retrieve the relevant records, preserve changes and disclosure history, and confirm completion to the responsible party. Separate direct electronic-copy duties from other delegated tasks.
routes.exact_clause_limit: Synthetic assistance terms exist; no authenticated electronic-copy, amendment or accounting request, retrieved record population or upstream completion event.

routes.authored_test_clause: Select downstream data flows independently from vendor lists; inspect signed scope and reporting paths. Exercise an unsuccessful cure and review documented termination feasibility.
routes.authored_title: Reconcile every subcontractor creating, receiving, maintaining or transmitting PHI to the applicable written arrangement before delegation. Review safeguards, security-incident/breach reporting, permitted uses, assistance and exit terms. On known material violation, record reasonable cure/end steps and, if unsuccessful, feasibility of termination.
routes.exact_clause_limit: One fictional downstream support chain and late-flowdown exception exist; no independent complete PHI-flow population, actual signed BAA, unsuccessful cure or termination-feasibility decision.
